name: SPAM Classic Canned Pork & Ham (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Contains mechanically processed pork shoulder and ham packed with 16g fat (6g saturated) and 790mg sodium per 2 oz slice. The extreme grease load and sodium nitrates provoke sharp biliary colic and rapid bowel dumping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active disease. Lean canned chicken breast or water-packed tuna are infinitely safer.
